sgsn.ip_bind.description: Local IP address the SGSN binds to for signaling and user-plane interfaces.

sgsn.msisdn.description: MSISDN (phone number) to bind to (optional, for specific subscriber identification).

sgsn.imei.description: IMEI to bind to (optional, for device-specific handling).

sgsn.auth_mode.description: Authentication mode: 'triplet' (pre-generated triplets), 'hlr' (real-time HLR query), or 'none'.

ggsn.ip.description: IP address of the local GGSN interface (used for SGSN-GGSN communication).

ggsn.pool_start.description: Start of the dynamic IP address pool assigned to subscribers.

ggsn.pool_end.description: End of the dynamic IP address pool assigned to subscribers.

ggsn.apn.description: Default APN used for PDP context activation (e.g., 'internet', 'ims').

ggsn.dns1.description: Primary DNS server to advertise to subscribers.

ggsn.dns2.description: Secondary DNS server to advertise to subscribers.

ggsn.ppp.description: Enable PPP over GTP for legacy support (e.g., 'enabled' or 'disabled').

sgsn.iu_cs_ip.description: Local IP address for Iu-CS (Circuit-Switched) signaling.

sgsn.iu_ps_ip.description: Local IP address for Iu-PS (Packet-Switched) signaling.

sgsn.iu_rnc_id.description: RNC (Radio Network Controller) identifier for UMTS Iu-PS connection.

sgsn.iu_ranap_debug.description: Enable RANAP (Radio Access Network Application Part) debug logging.

sgsn.auth_tuple_max_age.description: Maximum age (seconds) for cached authentication triplets before re-querying HLR.

sgsn.auth_tuple_reuse_on_error.description: If true, reuse last known-good triplet on HLR query failure (fallback behavior).

sgsn.use_hlr.description: If true, use HLR for subscriber lookups (requires HLR connection).

sgsn.hlr_ip.description: IP address of the HLR/SIP server (required if use_hlr=true).

sgsn.db_file.description: Path to local subscriber database file (if HLR not used).

sgsn.nse_nsei.description: NS Service Entity Identifier for BSSGP.

sgsn.nse_vci.description: NS Virtual Channel Identifier for BSSGP.

sgsn.cell_nsei.description: NSEI used for cell-level NS connections.

sgsn.cell_vci.description: VCI used for cell-level NS connections.

sgsn.ra.description: Routing Area Code in format MNC-MCC-RAC (e.g., '001-001-003').

sgsn.rac.description: Routing Area Code (RAC) for GSM (must match RA above).

sgsn.bssgp_neighbors.description: List of BSSGP neighbor SGSN/PCU IPs/ports for inter-SGSN handover.

sgsn.abis_ip.description: Local IP address for A-bis interface to BTS.

sgsn.abis_port.description: Local UDP port for A-bis interface (typically 9000).

sgsn.abis_timeslots.description: Comma-separated list of used subslots (e.g., '0-15' for full E1).

sgsn.abis_timeslots_list.description: List of specific timeslots to configure (alternative to abis_timeslots).

subslot.description: Subslot (0–7 for full rate, 0–15 for half rate).

name.description: Log category name (e.g., 'GMM' for GPRS Mobility Management).

sgsn.ctrl_ip.description: Control interface IP (localhost recommended for security).

sgsn.stats_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between statistics updates and reporting.

sgsn.timer_t3141.description: Timer T3141 (PDP Context Activity Timer) — inactivity timeout (seconds).

sgsn.timer_t3160.description: Timer T3160 (Attach Accept Timer) — max wait for attach completion (seconds).

sgsn.timer_t3170.description: Timer T3170 (Detach Timer) — inactivity timeout before forced detach (seconds).

sgsn.timer_n3141.description: Max retransmissions for T3141 (PDP context requests).

sgsn.mm_attach_tolerance.description: Delay (seconds) before accepting new attach requests after detach (prevents loops).

sgsn.rr_t3192.description: Timer T3192 (RR Busy) — inactivity for RR connection release (seconds).

sgsn.llc_max_burst.description: Maximum LLC frame burst size before pausing.
